note: Hindcast cases. Dates are civil days (Europe/Madrid). 'kind': major (red reached and verified), moderate, null (warning issued or threat signalled, little fell), ordinary (yellow-type rain), dry. Source of the catalogue: AEMET-CV monthly climate summaries, SAIH Jucar daily scan and press, see coord/findings/r6-events-science.md and coord/findings/q4-hindcast.md. Multi-day 'fill' cases start on the last day of the previous case on purpose (the 12-h accumulation needs the evening before); run.py keeps the first file for a duplicated hour.
